lines.en: : So if you want to dance around that, have at it. But I’m not a very good dancer, and I’d much prefer to abstain from such activities.

lines.en: : The point of pretending has come and gone. You know who I am now.

lines.zh: Io 的好感度下降了 10！

lines.en: I think I should leave Io alone for a little while...
lines.zh: 我想我应该让 Io 一个人待上一阵子……

lines.en: She’ll come to me if she ever wants to talk again.
lines.zh: 如果她还想再说话，她会来找我的。
